name: Kale Salad
dish: Raw shredded kale tossed with oven-roasted squash cubes, nuts and sharp cheddar in a lemon and oil dressing; main for two or a side.

stages.do: coat squash cubes in oil, season; roast, turning now and then
combine kale, roasted squash, nuts, cheddar
ingredients: Kale (lacinato or dinosaur), ribs removed and finely sliced

stages.do: dress: lemon juice + drizzle of oil; adjust salt/pepper; toss
optional shavings of hard cheese over top; serve

notes: Salt and pepper are not in the list (pantry). Hard cheese is optional and unmeasured.
